title: Rollup
description: Bundle libraries with Rollup: multiple output formats, externals, declaration files, and tree-shaking.

data.text: Rollup is optimised for libraries. It produces clean, tree-shakable ESM output and is the bundler underneath Vite, so understanding it explains a lot of Vite behaviour.

data.title: Library requirements Rollup handles well
items: Emit both ESM and CommonJS from one source.
Mark peer dependencies as `external` so they are not bundled.
Preserve module structure for better tree shaking.

data.caption: rollup.config.mjs — dual ESM/CJS library build

data.title: Bundling React into a library
data.text: If `react` is not marked external, consumers get a second copy and hooks fail with "Invalid hook call". External every peer dependency, and list it in `peerDependencies`.
Tree shaking depends on your code

Rollup removes unused exports only when modules are side-effect free. Set `"sideEffects": false` in `package.json` (or list files with side effects) and avoid top-level work such as registering globals, or consumers will import more than they need.

data.title: Build and inspect the output
data.code:
npm install -D rollup @rollup/plugin-node-resolve @rollup/plugin-commonjs @rollup/plugin-typescript rollup-plugin-dts
npx rollup -c
node -e "console.log(require('fs').statSync('dist/index.js').size)"

terms.definition: Dead-code elimination based on static ESM imports and exports.
A dependency Rollup leaves as an import instead of bundling it.
An output option that keeps one file per source module for better consumer tree shaking.
A package.json flag telling bundlers which modules can be safely dropped.

data.title: Key takeaways
points: Rollup is the library bundler: clean ESM, multiple formats, declarations.
Externals prevent peer dependencies from being bundled twice.
Tree shaking needs ESM plus a correct sideEffects declaration.
Vite uses Rollup for production builds, so these settings carry over.
data.takeaway: Library bundling is mostly about outputs and externals — the JavaScript transform is the easy part.
